issues.description: Function name mismatch for the distillation-circuit builder: the problem statement and solution use the name build_msd_circ(...), but the template defines build_msd_circuit(...). This inconsistency will confuse students about which function to implement and will likely cause tests or imports that expect build_msd_circ to fail.

The problem statement and the solution refer to the distillation-construction function as build_msd_circ(...), but the template repository provides a stub named build_msd_circuit(...). This mismatched identifier for the same conceptual entity (the function that constructs the magic-state-distillation circuit) creates a mapping barrier: students reading the problem will implement/expect build_msd_circ, but the provided template exposes build_msd_circuit. This will likely cause failing tests or confusion about which function to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) (or add a small wrapper alias def build_msd_circ(...): return build_msd_circuit(...)) so it matches the problem statement and the solution implementation. Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use build_msd_circuit everywhere — pick one name and apply it uniformly to avoid student confusion and test mismatches.
